BAh7CEkiCGdpZAY6BkVUSSI6Z2lkOi8vanVtcHN0.title: I Got Better at AI. My Company Slowed Down.
BAh7CEkiCGdpZAY6BkVUSSI6Z2lkOi8vanVtcHN0.description:
I got better at AI, but the company didn’t scale with me.

At one of my companies, I learned the hard way that founder leverage with AI can turn the founder into the bottleneck. The more effective I became, the more the company depended on me.

In this video, I break down why that happens, what changed when we stopped centering AI around me, and how building AI capability inside the team led to better workflows, faster decisions, and more innovation than I would have created on my own.

If you’re a founder, CEO, operator, or business owner using AI to scale a team, this video is about the hidden AI trap: when one person’s speed becomes everyone else’s dependency.

You’ll learn:
- Why founder-led AI adoption can slow a company down
- How founder leverage becomes company dependence
- What changed when operators started building workflows
- Why team AI capability beats founder-only AI advantage
- How better systems create faster decisions and more innovation
